units: Dated events and approximate named-place coordinates in longitude/latitude degrees
note: Original paraphrases linked to institutional histories and primary documents. Markers locate cities or regions, not territorial extent, exact ceremonies or front lines. Years are conventional historical years; dates before 1582 follow the historical Julian calendar unless noted.

items.title: Aachen
items.text: Otto I became king at Aachen in 936.

items.title: Rome
items.text: The pope invested Otto I with the imperial title in 962.

items.title: Quedlinburg
items.text: Quedlinburg was a royal centre under the Saxon-Ottonian dynasty (919–1024); 1000 is a period anchor, not a founding date.

items.title: Hildesheim
items.text: Bishop Bernward’s Hildesheim commissioned major works informed by ancient imperial and Christian monuments. 1000 identifies the cultural period, not a precise commission date.
